entities.name: Table T1 – Future GW-scale data center architecture
entities.brief: Hierarchical data center power delivery architecture featuring voltage step-down and advanced materials.
entities.description: Outlines multi-stage power conversion from MV AC to serverboard core, leveraging SiC and GaN components and energy storage to enable high-power AI data centers.

properties.table_content:
| Stage/Location   | Component/Function         | Voltage Transformation             | Key Materials/Description                                           |
|------------------|----------------------------|------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Infrastructure   | AC/DC Converter            | MV AC Grid Input to 800V DC Output | Utilizes SiC and High Power Modules                                 |
|                  | Long Duration Energy Storage | 800V DC Bus to V_bat             | Lithium-ion Batteries (Li-ion), requires SiC for DC/DC conversion   |
| Hall             | DC/DC Converter            | 800V DC Bus                        | Connects medium duration storage to the 800V bus                   |
|                  | Medium Duration Energy Storage | 800V DC Bus to V_bat             | Super Capacitors / New Battery Chemistry, requires SiC for DC/DC conversion |
| Row / IT Rack    | DC/DC Converter            | 800V DC Bus                        | Connects short duration storage to the 800V bus                    |
|                  | Short Duration Energy Storage | 800V DC Bus to V_bat             | Electrolytic Capacitors, requires SiC for DC/DC conversion          |
| Serverboard      | HV IBC (High Voltage IBC)  | 800V DC Input to 54V/12V DC Output | Employs GaN for efficient high-voltage conversion                   |
|                  | LV IBC (Low Voltage IBC)   | 54V DC Input to 12V/6V DC Output   | Uses GaN, Silicon (Si), and Control ICs                             |
|                  | VRM (Voltage Regulator Module)| 12V/6V DC Input to Core Voltage  | Employs Silicon (Si) and Control ICs for final power delivery       |
| System-wide      | Safety Breakers            | Across 800V DC Bus                 | Ensures system safety at various stages                             |
properties.key_insight: The Future GW-scale data center architecture progressively steps down voltage from an MV AC grid to core levels (800V DC→54V→12V/6V), integrating SiC and GaN materials with distributed energy storage at each stage.
